privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Wishly lets you create gift wishlists and share them with a link. This page explains what data the service handles and how the app works today.

collect.title: What we store
collect.body: If you create wishlists, we store your email address (from Google or an email sign-in link) and the wishlists and gifts you add: titles, notes, product and image links, and prices. Guests who reserve a gift are not asked for any personal data. For a reservation we store only a one-way hash of a random code created in the guest’s browser, so nobody, including the list owner, can see who reserved a gift.

browser.title: What stays in your browser
browser.body: Wishly uses your browser’s local storage, not tracking cookies, for your language choice, your sign-in session, the page to return to after signing in, and the random codes that let you cancel your own reservations. If you clear this data on a device, you can no longer cancel reservations made there. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers.

providers.title: Who processes data for us
providers.body: Supabase provides the database, sign-in and server functions. Cloudflare delivers the website and sees technical request data such as IP addresses. If you choose Google sign-in, Google handles that login. Sign-in emails are sent by the email provider the operator has configured. When you import a product from a link, our server fetches that web page; no third-party preview service is used.

links.title: Shared links
links.body: A shared wishlist link works like a key: anyone who has it can see the list and reserve gifts, and the page is hidden from search engines. Share it only with people you trust. You can create a new link at any time, which immediately stops the old one from working.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: Wishlists, gifts and reservations are kept until you delete them. Deleting a wishlist also deletes its gifts and reservations. Account data is kept while you use the service. Self-service account deletion is not available yet: contact the operator to have your account and data removed.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask the operator to give you access to your personal data, correct it or delete it, and to restrict or object to its processing. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
